author: Cleo Abram
description:
The deeper you go, the weirder it gets. Beautiful, bizarre creatures thrive in the cold dark depths of our oceans. 

Until now though, most of our discoveries have just required decades of work for the chance to just get… lucky. Now, there’s a new way to discover the animals hidden in the deepest oceans.

And all you need is a bit of water…

For more on how, subscribe!

#oceans #exploration #shorts
title: What’s Hiding In The Deepest Ocean?
